title: League Champions
criteria: Team with the highest total points at the end of the league season.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Tiebreakers: goal difference, goals scored, then head-to-head record.

title: First Run-up (league)
criteria: Team finishing second in league standings at season end.

title: Second Run-up (league)
criteria: Team finishing third in league standings at season end.

title: CPL Cup Champions
criteria: Winner of the CPL Cup final.

title: First Run-up (CPL Cup)
criteria: Runner-up in the CPL Cup final.

title: Second Run-up (CPL Cup)
criteria: Best-performing losing semifinalist in the CPL Cup competition.

title: CPL Player of the Season (league A/B)
criteria: Most outstanding individual selected through combined vote of CPL Technical Committee and Registered CPL Referee Council.

title: Golden Glove (league A/B)
criteria: Goalkeeper with the most clean sheets in the league season.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Tiebreaker: fewer goals conceded per match.

title: Golden Glove (CPL Cup)
criteria: Goalkeeper with the most clean sheets in the CPL Cup tournament.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Tiebreaker: fewer goals conceded in the knockout stage.

title: Golden Boot (league A/B)
criteria: Player with the most goals scored in the league season.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Tiebreakers: fewest penalties scored, fewer matches played, then more assists.

title: Golden Boot (CPL Cup)
criteria: Player with the most goals scored in the CPL Cup tournament.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Knockout-stage goals prioritized, then fewer penalties scored.

title: Playmaker/Most Assists (league A/B)
criteria: Player with the most assists in the league season.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Tiebreakers: fewer matches played, then fewer disciplinary points.

title: Playmaker/Most Assists (CPL Cup)
criteria: Player with the most assists in the CPL Cup tournament.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Knockout-stage assists prioritized, then fewer matches played.

title: CPL Best Manager of the Season
criteria: Manager achieving the best league standings relative to squad quality, tactical innovation and clean disciplinary record; no red card to technical bench.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Selected by CPL Technical Committee and CPL Registered Referee Council.

title: CPL Best Referee of the Season (Inclusive of AR)
criteria: On-field centre or assistant referee with highest average match assessor ratings and no controversial decisions overturned by CPL Review Panel.

title: CPL Best Young Player
criteria: Player aged 23 or under as season begins, with at least 5 goals, assists or tackles won in league; performance relative to age, consistency and growth trajectory.

title: CPL Most Disciplined Player
criteria: Player with zero red cards and fewest yellow cards, no misconduct reports or fines.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Selected by CPL Registered Referees Panel and CPL Technical Committee.

title: CPL Team of the Season
criteria: Best XI selected on clean sheets, tackles won, interceptions, assists, pass completion, chances created, goals scored and shots on target.

title: CPL Most Disciplined Team
criteria: Team with lowest disciplinary points: 3 per red card and 1 per yellow card; zero fines or misconduct sanctions and positive referee reports.

title: CPL Best Official of the Season
criteria: Non-refereeing CPL Organizing Committee official assessed on organizational efficiency, zero match reporting errors, punctuality and stakeholder feedback.
tie_breakers_or_notes: Selected by Technical bench (Coaches) and CPL Refereeing Council.
